firstPlayerRule: The player who used a tool most recently receives the first player token and starts the Market Phase.
clarifications: During the Market Phase, turns continue clockwise from the token holder.
The Work Phase is simultaneous. At its end, pass the first player token to the next player clockwise for the following round.

internalEvidence: Visually checked publisher-authored English booklet preserved by 1jour-1jeu.
